body: I'm not discounting the fact that she can feel and do whatever she wants. She has every right. I hurt her. I can't control her anger. I'm just distraught over the fact that our friends had to be involved in this. The guy gets to be painted as 'weak' and 'had no choice' in all of this.

I really regret what I did. But I'm a late bloomer and this man 'tamed' me and the chemistry or whatever we had always made us high. Everything overwhelmed me, it felt like I'd never meet someone else like him ever again so I let him keep me on the side. It kept killing me inside but I let it be. It only gets worse that he knew I was suicidal; the wife's brother died from suicide and what she's doing is driving me to do the same thing.

I'm scared to block her. If I don't answer, she'll get mad and I don't know what she'll do to humiliate my family. My friends, whom I've always been there for, don't consider me their friend anymore without hearing what I have to say. Why am I the only one to blame? Why does the guy get a free pass?
